desc: Elevate shooting experience with the Walther PDP F-SERIES PRO. Built with Walthers hallmark TEQ (Trigger, Ergonomics, and Quality) philosophy, the PDP F-SERIES PRO is the ultimate tool for precision, reliability, and control. Available in both 3.5" and 4" barrel lengths. The PFP F-Series PRO features a precision-engineered aluminum magwell, designed to enhance reload speed for faster transitions. Paired with extended magazine base pads, the 18-round capacity magazines offer not only increased firepower but also ease of handling.
